title: Strategies and ML pages as catalogs: one card per strategy / model with a status chip (inactive / shadow / testing / live-production) and a review chip (reviewed in the last 7 days, passed, status confirmed). Card opens to: symbol, timeframe, accounts; strategy rules as a clear plain-language breakdown; data indicators (strategies) or training features + weights/importances (models); version, last training, last review, last update; performance (decisions made, good vs bad decisions, net $ / R) plus standard comparison statistics; every statistic has a hover/click definition (what it is, how it is computed, where it comes from)
note: Operator 2026-10-29 ~11:20Z (chat, verbatim excerpts): "I want each of those items to have its own card so that I can see clearly ... the whole catalog of strategies ... and ... MLs, with like some indicator of its status ... For the MLs, I also want to see the weights. For the strategies ... a clear breakdown of what exactly the rules that it's using are ... add other statistics there that are like important for comparison, even if I don't know them ... add like a hover over option ... so I can ... learn as we're going." Statuses come from scripts/ops/strategy_status.py (derived, never a field) and the ML registry; numbers carry provenance (MEASURED/ESTIMATED; null renders as —).
